title: Candidate record — a work item, not a rating
status: PROPOSED — MiniMax (S-1900–1999), 21 Oct 2026, aligned with the Owner's product direction (PR #4). The Owner approves the final pool; the council assembles and reviews candidates.
why_a_separate_shape: Under the Owner's direction the supplied notes are SOURCE MATERIAL. A mention is not a candidate until it has provenance, and it is not a rating until the Owner approves it. Mixing candidates and records in one file is how invented ratings get shipped (the hard-rule violation reported in bulletin M-84). This shape therefore forbids a rating field outright.

record.id: stable candidate id, lowercase ascii, never derived from the display name
record.name: display name as the source gives it; disambiguate when the source allows
record.status: always 'candidate — not a record, not a rating'
record.historical_team_abbrs: team abbreviations exactly as the source wrote them (KC, STL, SF …) — HISTORICAL CONTEXT ONLY
record.historical_team_texts: historical team names as the source wrote them ('Milwaukee Hawks')
record.jerseys_seen: jersey numbers seen in the source, with the source line
record.years_seen: years seen in the source (era hints), never a rating
record.source_mentions: [{ file, line, text }] — every mention, with its citation
record.possible_duplicates_of: surname-only mentions that may be the same person as a fuller candidate — a SUGGESTION for the curator, never a merge
record.conflicts: source-internal disagreements (two jerseys, two teams, two years) and same-surname warnings
record.open_questions: what a curator must answer: modern franchise, position candidate(s), career status and its source, identity confirmation, and later the peak season and rating

rules: NO RATING FIELD. A candidate must not carry an OVR or any other rating; the validator fails a candidate pool that does (validate-dataset.mjs, candidate mode).
Source material only: a mention becomes a candidate with provenance; a candidate becomes a rating only with the Owner's approval.
Historical team context and today's franchise are different fields and must never be merged.
Never merge two candidates because their names match — the intake contains same-name different-person collisions; the curator confirms identity.
Public-facing numbers are integers; internal calculations may use decimals; do not invent fields the engine does not use.
